posts.subject: [ENG] Application as Admin on the Dream Minigame Server
posts.bodyHtml: I am Eetu Parkkonen known as "PaskaSankari" and i live in Finland. I'm 15 years old. I want to be admin because i've played quite long on this server and i really like it. My hobby is skiing, i dont ski that often but sometimes i do. On week i play usually from 14.00 to 18.00 and on weekends i play usually whole day. I think im quite good in english, but im not that good in German. I think i would be good admin. [thanksforit*] [dream*] [thanksforit*]

You should talk a little bit more i show you now the requierements in english [^^]
1. You need to be active in the Teamspeak, Forum (if youre not able to speak german its not possible i believe), and ingame
2. Many rounds on the Server
3. You need a headset
4. You need adssertiveness
5. You need maturity
6. Be friendly to the user
7. You need to talk german, but on the minigame server its not really possible
8. You need to know that youre a good admin
9. You need to be loyality over the community


Have fun and play on the Server, the application is shit but from my side its a yes, because you made an application on a german forum and that is hard with no german skill :D.

Yeah as you can see, some admins here also have problems with english. (Actually kinda sad haha.)


You might just look at your application and then again look at the requirements, i would recommend you to do so and write your application again.

If you really want to apply as an Admin you should consider making a better application.
Here are the Requirements and the Application Form.
But please don't copy and paste it, try to figure out a better way of writing a nice application, don't just go point by point.
It should be readable fluidly.


Requirements:
1. Active on the Server you're applying, Teamspeak (and the Forum - not necessary, since you won't understand much)
2. Many VIP/Stamm Points on our Servers
3 You need a Headset
4. You need to persist on your opinion
5. Maturity
6. You need to be friendly to other Users
7. Not necessary for somebody, that can't speak German very well
8. You need to think of yourself as a capable and action-aware Admin
9. Be loyal to the Community you're applying. Don't talk shit about it.


Application Form:
1. What's your name? Ingame and Real-Life
2. How old are you?
3. Why are you applying as an Admin on Dream?
4. How long are you already playing on our Servers?
5. What are your Hobbys?
6. Can you estimate how mature you are?
7. Do you have any experience as Admin?
8. When are you normally available/online?
9. User A insults User B with the phrase "You son of a bitch". How do you react?
10. What are your strenghs?
11) What are your weaknesses?
12) Closing Words
